name: Aspire CLI
description: User-writable Aspire CLI install via the official installer (~/.aspire), with optional bundle setup and create-time alignment to the repo Aspire SDK pin.

aspireVersion.description: Aspire CLI version passed to the official installer, or latest for the selected quality at image build with optional repo alignment on container create.

quality.description: Installer quality when aspireVersion is latest. Ignored when aspireVersion is pinned.

bundlePath.description: Aspire layout root for ASPIRE_LAYOUT_PATH and aspire setup. Empty uses $HOME/.aspire under the container user (Aspire 17+ creates bundle/ as a symlink there).

runSetupOnInstall.description: Run aspire setup --non-interactive after installing or updating the CLI.
